name: ViewColumnDef
docs:
Column definition specified in a `CREATE VIEW` statement.

Syntax
```markdown
<name> [data_type][OPTIONS(option, ...)]

option: <name> = <value>
```

Examples:
```sql
name
age OPTIONS(description = "age column", tag = "prod")
amount COMMENT 'The total amount for the order line'
created_at DateTime64
```
